causalInterpretation.interpretation: Execution observations reached all treatment quality-repair phases but did not improve full acceptance. All first and repaired candidates passed the finite functional oracle. This epoch therefore does not demonstrate either a functional reasoning gain or successful structural constraint repair.

research.scope: Primary author survey motivates executable observations and relation/oracle separation; does not establish this mechanism improves NYX.

conflicts: A functional pass is not full acceptance. No favorable confidence label or relaxed gate may convert this negative result into promotion.

nextEvidenceSupportedAction: Investigate why quantitative quality feedback produces insufficient algorithmic restructuring. Develop an explicit constraint-consistent refactoring strategy on separate development programs; reject declaration packing that only games the counter. Test on fresh tasks without changing the oracle. Post-pass observation value remains unexercised in this epoch.
